name: network_interdiction_and_robust_placement
qualification: not_qualified: bounded deterministic reference and focused native tests, not INT-FNX-001 or physical coverage qualification
tieBreak: maximum minimum disable cost, then installation cost, cardinality and sensor tuple
complexityWitness: placement branches, removal branches, path searches and adjacency scans
outputSizeWitness: selected additions plus baseline and selected exact removal sets and witness paths
objective: maximize the minimum sensor-disable cost opening an unobserved entry-to-target walk, subject to installation and addition-count ceilings
numericPolicy: separate named u64 installation and disable-cost units; zero costs allowed; sum of every declared disable cost must fit u64; unaffordable installation subsets are rejected by checked subtraction, never wrapped
constraints: candidate identities are distinct from every baseline sensor and each other
every observed baseline sensor has an explicit disable cost
all observer, entry and target zones exist in the movement projection
empty candidate support is retained as an explicit no-benefit assumption
the empty placement is always considered
one work budget and cancellation source covers all nested searches
no partial answer or heuristic fallback on refusal
a disconnected movement graph remains unreachable, never infinite robustness
compatibility: additive placement mode; existing interdiction input, output, decision and implementation identities remain unchanged
noClaims: optimality outside the complete supplied catalog and declared movement/observer model
